attBesluta.text: Arrived quickly, super easy to install. I put in an 8’ single and a 16’ double. Both went in surprisingly easy. I did use help on the 16’ section to pull it along

Great product. Took some effort to install,easier if you spray the track and seal with wd40. I found it worked alot better then using soap etc. The seal is if great quality. Highly durable, flexible. And it sealed my door perfectly. Will definitely purchase this again when needed. Also cheaper here then alot of hardware /garage repair stores. Doesn't disappoint. 👍🏻

One star off because the O-ring is flat. The tubing-shaped design would've been great if it had stayed round, providing cushioning when the door closes. To fix it, I bought a 3/4-inch-OD clear rubber hose and inserted it into the O-ring. It keeps the ring round, cushions the door, and maintains a good seal.
